title: Pari E2e No Oracle H1 Root
objective: Implement a no-oracle prepared h1 composition root connecting resident candidate, precision rebuild, compact unit/getfu, cleanarch, torsion/regulator, and immutable final evidence through neutral component APIs

oracles: Cold replay of resident-derived exact authorities without fixture or external process access inside the composition boundary

handoff.summary: Adds the first connected prepared h=1 root whose computation boundary rebuilds the 2176-bit embedding and unit logs from qualified resident roots and exact relation products, binds them to detached exact-unit/regulator/torsion authorities, and publishes an immutable internally correspondence-complete but publicly incomplete result.
risks: The detached unit and regulator authorities are prepared outside the root and retain pinned fixture provenance; no fixture or live oracle is available inside the root itself.
The 2176-bit and historical 192-bit logarithm evaluations agree for at least 176 leading bits rather than being bit-identical.
Unit saturation and global factor-base/relation completeness remain explicit public blockers.
next_steps: Integrate this root after the neutral embedding component and invoke it from the shared final driver.
Replace detached fixture provenance with a fully live unit-selection authority when that upstream component is available.
Supply independent saturation and global completeness evidence before enabling a public class/unit result.
